name: dup-worker-check
summary: Stops a second worker from starting on a ticket a live worker already holds.

env.DUP_PROJECTS_ROOT: where Claude Code keeps transcripts, default ~/.claude/projects
env.DUP_LIVE_MIN: minutes of silence before a worker counts as not live, default 15
env.DUP_TICKET_RE: optional pattern for a ticket id, default L- plus four digits (what the ledger hands out)
